title: Gaussian noise convergence at full correlation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be integrable with respect to standard Gaussian measure $\gamma_n$. As $\rho$ approaches $1$ from below, the $L^1(\gamma_n)$ norm of $T_\rho f-f$ tends to zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ is integrable with respect to $\gamma_n$
